before.description: For those days you may want your lips CLEAR. It feels luxurious and creamy as it’s in omega fatty acids and antioxidants for intensive instant relief to dry lips. It’s so soft, you can even use it on babies. If applied in the nighttime, you’ll have plumped and hydrated pout in the morning. Say bye to harsh winters and cracked lips! Not only does it work wonders on dry, cracked lips — as well as chapped areas anywhere on the body — but it's also lightweight, non-sticky, and leaves behind a silky sheen that doesn't disappear after an hour. You can't go wrong with this one.

A thin layer of the antioxidant-rich CLEAR adds the prettiest subtle sheen to lips, and it layers nicely with lipstick.
